description: This file defines the PhotoThumbnailFragment class, which is an Android Fragment responsible for displaying a grid of photo thumbnails fetched from Picasa RSS feed. It manages loading data using CursorLoader, configuring views, handling user interactions, and binding data to the UI using a custom CursorAdapter.

classes.name: PhotoThumbnailFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment displaying a grid of photo thumbnails retrieved from an RSS feed, managing data loading, user interaction, and view binding.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a loader that queries the image URLs from the ContentProvider.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, initializes views and data adapters, sets up the grid view, and starts data loading.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up references and resources to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: onHiddenChanged
methods.description: Handles visibility changes of the fragment.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Handles user click on a thumbnail, broadcasting the intent to show full image.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Updates the adapter with new data when loading is complete.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Clears adapter data when loader is reset.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves fragment state such as visibility status.

methods.name: setLoaded
methods.description: Sets internal flag indicating whether data is loaded.

inner_classes.name: GridViewAdapter
inner_classes.description: A custom CursorAdapter to bind image URLs to views in the grid.

methods.name: bindView
methods.description: Binds data from cursor to view, initiating image download as necessary.

methods.name: newView
methods.description: Creates new view instances for grid items, inflating layout and setting parameters.
